entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think the cognitive version of a person[n]would transform into such a horrible[n]monster and attack us...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That means our enemies aren't limited[n]to Shadows.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I thought the other people were just[n]victims, like the slaves at the castle or[n]the walking ATMs.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even though they seem to be alive,[n]they're only part of the backdrop...[n]the environment.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In other words, the Palace ruler[n]determines the form and strength of[n]their cognitions.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I would have loved to ask Futaba's mother[n]how far along she was with her research...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Research, huh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She was lookin' into that cognitive[n]psience stuff, yeah?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we put together all the information[n]we've gathered up to this point...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Abuse of cognitive psience can lead to[n]death, and it may even relate to the[n]psychotic breakdown incidents.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Considering the "cognitive" aspect,[n]I sense a strong connection between it[n]and the Metaverse.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: On top of that, the research might have[n]been stolen and used by someone else.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You mean those guys that showed[n]Futaba-chan the fake suicide note.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If that is the case, those people are[n]unforgivable.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, Futaba. Is there anything else you[n]can remember?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She is quite difficult...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That smell...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: C'mon, no fair...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, can I snag a bite?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Meanie.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why don't we take a short break?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've been thinking...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even if Futaba is a genius, could she[n]really crush an international hacker[n]organization that easily?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The one who taunted the Phantom[n]Thieves was a guy in Japan.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I knew the Medjed members in Japan[n]weren't anything special, so I wasn't[n]worried.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How do you know that?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 'Cause I'm the founder.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um... what do you mean?[n]Should we take that literally?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yep. It was only me at first, back when[n]I was referred to as the hacker of justice.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But since I stayed anonymous, a bunch of[n]guys from all over the world started using[n]the name.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And those were the ones committing[n]cybercrimes.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It was a hassle to expose all of them, so[n]I just left them be.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uhhh... so Futaba was the true Medjed,[n]and we were freakin' out over some[n]weak-ass dipshits?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You should've told us from the start,[n]Futaba.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I discarded the Medjed name a while ago.[n]I'm Alibaba now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba, what do you want to do now?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Since you know our secret, we'd like you[n]to join our team.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: 'Kay.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Just like that?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This may even ensure our investigation[n]of Mementos goes along smoothly.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well... I guess.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, Futaba's real amazin'! She's gonna[n]be a big help for us, huh?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Say, Futaba.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How did you find out about us?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Secret.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Where did you learn to hack?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Private.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: When did you obtain the Nav?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I refuse to answer.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba-chan sure is unique...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Still, it'll be a problem if she doesn't[n]open up to us some more.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: At the very least, we need to be able to[n]communicate normally with her.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What should we do?
Let's get to know her.
She's okay as is.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, that ain't gonna fly.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: First, we'll need to help her open up to us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we each spend an entire day with her,[n]maybe she'll get more used to being[n]around us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see. We do have the time, thanks to[n]summer vacation.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We can begin tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's go to the beach! There'll be tonsa[n]people there, plus we got totally dried[n]out in that desert.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's a great idea! I forgot I hadn't gone[n]to the beach yet!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uh, excuse me...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll come by tomorrow. See you then.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let me help as well. I don't have anything[n]planned.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thanks. We can set a schedule with[n]everyone else depending on when[n]they're free.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Can I really do this?
Good luck.
It'll be a disaster.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Why me!?
